1u7dp5j:169: The core innovation of this framework is dividing data into three processing paths by sensitivity: S1 public data connects directly to the strongest cloud model, S2 sensitive information goes to the cloud after desensitization, and S3 top-secret information is forced to local processing. This routing logic is not a simple "sensitive means local"; instead, the local engine (MiniCPM) acts as a router to decide data flow—the local model determines which level data belongs to, rather than requiring users to classify manually. This design lowers the usage barrier while ensuring automatic enforcement of security policies.
